fullDescription: A high-security, corporate-grade dark mode design system tailored for technical SaaS and fintech. Features a neutral grayscale palette, precision-engineered UI elements like corner brackets and grid backgrounds, and a focus on reliability. Ideal for document management, cybersecurity dashboards, and AI indexing platforms that prioritize trust over visual drama. Includes editorial typography pairing (Cabinet Grotesk and General Sans), subtle micro-interactions, and a clear step-based flow.

structured.summary: A minimalist, security-centric dark UI featuring a subtle 48px grid background, editorial-style typography, and desaturated grayscale accents. The layout emphasizes a central focus area for file processing, bracketed by precision-styled navigation and status bars.

style.description: The style is 'Professional Security-First Dark Mode'. It utilizes a deep black background (#0d0d0d) with a subtle white grid overlay (2.5% opacity) and radial vignette. Typography pairs the bold, geometric Cabinet Grotesk for headings with the clean, legible General Sans for UI elements. The color palette is strictly limited to blacks, grays, and whites to convey authority and neutrality. Interactive elements use semi-transparent white backgrounds (3-9% opacity) and thin borders (1px) to create depth without using drop shadows.
style.prompt:
Create a high-fidelity, security-focused dark UI using the following specifications:
- **Color Palette**: Background: #0d0d0d; Surfaces: #1a1a1a; Primary Borders: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); Secondary Borders: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); Text High: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); Text Med: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); Text Low: rgba(255,255,255,0.2).
- **Typography**: Headings use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (700 weight, -0.03em letter-spacing). Body and UI elements use 'General Sans' (400, 500, 600 weights). Base font size is 14px.
- **Background**: 48px square grid using linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px). Add a radial vignette from center (transparent) to edges (rgba(0,0,0,0.55)).
- **Animations**: Use a sequential 'fadeUp' entrance (opacity 0 to 1, translate 16px to 0) over 0.55s with 0.1s staggering. Hover states should use 0.2s ease transitions.
- **Borders/Corners**: Use 1.5px dashed borders for drop zones and 1px solid borders for standard components. Corner radii should range from 7px (small) to 16px (large).

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical three-tier structure: a thin top navigation bar, a flexible central workspace, and a high-precision bottom status bar.

prompts.prompt: Height: ~65px. Border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Left side: Logo mark (28x28px, #1a1a1a background, 1px border) with a 13px shield icon. Right side: Horizontal list of links (13.5px, color: 0.4 opacity white) with 32px spacing. Ends with a 'Sign in' button: transparent background, 7px 18px padding, 1px border (0.12 opacity).

A fullscreen flex area with 32px padding. Inside, a 100% width/height container ('Drop Zone') with a 1.5px dashed border (rgba(255,255,255,0.15)) and 16px radius. Feature four L-shaped 'corner brackets' (18x18px, 1px solid white at 0.12 opacity) positioned 14px from each corner. Content inside is centered: a 64x64px icon box, a 28px title, 14px subtext, and a horizontal divider with a central 'OR' text (11px, uppercase).

Height: ~55px. Border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Left: Progress indicators (three 5px dots, active dot at 0.55 opacity, others at 0.15). Center: Step text (11.5px, 0.18 opacity). Right: Security badge consisting of an 11px lock icon and 'End-to-end encrypted' text.

special_ui_components.description: A small metadata tag for file types.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a pill-shaped badge: padding 4px 12px, radius 6px, background rgba(255,255,255,0.03), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Contains a 10px icon and 11.5px text in General Sans Medium. Color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3).

A 64x64px square with 14px radius. Background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04). Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1). On parent hover, the box should translate -3px vertically with a 0.35s ease-out transition. Icon size inside: 26px, color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55).

Position: bottom 28px, centered horizontally. Background: #1a1a1a. Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Radius: 8px. Padding: 10px 18px. Contents: 15px check-circle icon + 13px text (rgba(255,255,255,0.75)). Animation: Fade and slide from translateY(16px) to 0.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain a strict grayscale palette; any use of vibrant color will break the security-focused aesthetic. MUST: Use subtle delays in animations to create a premium feel. MUST: Ensure all borders are semi-transparent to allow the background grid to peek through slightly. DO NOT: Use heavy drop shadows or large blurs. DO NOT: Use standard system fonts; stick to the specified geometric and grotesque pairings.
